title: Andrew Gallimore DMT experiments and entities with consistent taxonomies

tellings.quote: and I know you're working with Andrew Gallammore who does, you know, these DMT experiments,

plain: A researcher named Andrew Gallimore runs experiments with DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, in which people report meeting beings that seem to fall into the same consistent types from one person to the next. Michels brings this up only in passing, noting that his guest, the scientist Donald Hoffman, is working with Gallimore. The point is that if different people meet the same kinds of beings, those beings might be more than imagination.
